name: page-toolbar
title: Page toolbar
description: Toolbar above a list or table: search, a filters slot, a view toggle and the primary action, with roving focus. searchDebounceMs (default 0, a call per keystroke) delays onSearchChange until typing pauses; the input shows each keystroke at once, and Enter, an emptied input and unmount report at once, while a controlled search changed from outside replaces the draft.
author: gntik-ai
